# 🪪 AGR-109 · `book-editing-pipeline`

> Take a manuscript through developmental, line and copy edit passes with author sign-off before typesetting.

| Card ID | Domain | Pattern | Nodes | Edges | Verifiers | Routers | Max steps | Risk surface |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AGR-109` | creative-production | **pipeline** | 6 | 6 | 0 | 0 | 35 | execute |

> 🎯 **Requires a goal** — the manuscript to edit and the editorial brief it must meet. Without one the graph refuses and runs no node.

## The graph

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    N0["assess<br/><i>critic</i>"]
    N1["dev-edit<br/><i>producer</i>"]
    N2["line-edit<br/><i>producer</i>"]
    N3["copy-edit<br/><i>critic</i>"]
    N4["author-signoff<br/><i>approver</i>"]
    N5["typeset<br/><i>executor</i>"]
    N0 --> N1
    N1 --> N2
    N2 --> N3
    N3 -->|len(style_violations) > 0 and attempts < 2| N2
    N3 -->|len(style_violations) == 0| N4
    N4 --> N5
```

Legend: `[/…/]` router · `{{…}}` verifier · `[…]` worker/agent node.

## What it does

Developmental, line, and copy edits in ordered passes.

## Why it should deliver results

Staged specialists each own one narrow concern, so quality problems are localized to the stage that produced them instead of being smeared across a single mega-prompt. Output only leaves the graph through the exit contract.

- **Exit contract** — nothing typesets with open style violations or without author sign-off
- **Machine-checked** — `len(output.style_violations) == 0`
- **Machine-checked** — `output.signed_off == true`
- **Bounded** — hard stop after 35 steps; every loop edge is condition-guarded
- **Golden cases** — `uv run agr eval book-editing-pipeline` replays recorded cases through the real edge/assert logic (mock runner proves mechanics; `--live` measures your model)
- **Trace gallery** — [every case's route, node outputs, and checked asserts](../../../docs/traces/book-editing-pipeline.md)

## How to work with it

```bash
uv run agr show book-editing-pipeline       # full definition
uv run agr profile book-editing-pipeline    # deterministic structural facts
uv run agr mermaid book-editing-pipeline    # regenerate the diagram below
uv run agr eval book-editing-pipeline       # run golden cases (add --live for your endpoint)
uv run agr adapt book-editing-pipeline --target langgraph > app.py   # compile to runnable LangGraph
uv run agr optimize book-editing-pipeline   # propose bounded structural improvements (dry-run)
```

Over MCP: `uv run agr mcp` exposes the registry (search / show / profile) to any MCP client.
To evolve it: `uv run agr infuse book-editing-pipeline <node> <ability>` — every mutation is gate-checked and appended to the graph's lineage log.

## Node roster

| Node | Speciality | Kind | Abilities |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assess` | critic | agent | critique |
| `dev-edit` | producer | agent | generate |
| `line-edit` | producer | agent | generate |
| `copy-edit` | critic | agent | critique |
| `author-signoff` | approver | human | approve |
| `typeset` | executor | agent | execute_step |

## Edge logic

| From | To | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| `assess` | `dev-edit` | always |
| `dev-edit` | `line-edit` | always |
| `line-edit` | `copy-edit` | always |
| `copy-edit` | `line-edit` | len(style_violations) > 0 and attempts < 2 |
| `copy-edit` | `author-signoff` | len(style_violations) == 0 |
| `author-signoff` | `typeset` | always |

- **cloud-cost-optimizer** (devops-sre, pipeline) — Scan usage, propose rightsizing, verify against SLO headroom. *Verify:* projected savings computed from real billing export.
